test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: I thought I was going to die.
I thought I was going to diye.
I thought I was goinng to die.
I thught I was going to die.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **sentence with no spelling error **is:* "I thought I was going to die."*
 
• *"I thought I was going to die." *is **grammatically correct** with all words correctly spelled.
 
• The errors in the other sentences are as follows:
 
 
• **"Diye" **should be spelled as "die".** "Diye"** is not a valid English word in this context.
 
• **"Goinng" **is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"going".**
 
• **"Thught" **is a misspelling. The correct spelling is **"thought".**
 
 
 
• In terms of grammar and spelling, the correct sentence "I thought I was going to die." is a simple past tense sentence where the speaker is expressing a past belief or feeling that they were going to die.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is:* 'I thought I was going to die.'*
